_about: THE PLACES THE BAR CAN NAME (RUN TWO [the bar names the news], baked by tools/bohemia_run2_bar_news_places.py; never edit by hand). The towns the map's loop arrives at: the faction seats on the valley's 384 m cells (x east, y south), how a keeper says each one, and the reach a rumour carries. The news itself is never stored here: slices/bohemia_bar_news.js reads each town's situation from the map's own dice (engine/bohemia_livingmap.js traitsFor) and FACTIONS' raid ledger on the map's day, so what the keeper says is what you find when you get there.
source: slices/BOHEMIA_CITY_WORLD.html CT_BASES_BAKED (seed "bohemia"), the table loopTownAt reads
reach_why: Battle Brothers' tavern names an item up to 30 tiles out on a 140-tile map (wiki 1931 Tavern Rumors); scaled to the region's 496 cells that is 106 (ECONOMY day 75, 3b). Every valley seat is inside it, so the keeper tells the nearest town with news first.
